correctness.rationale: Directly enumerated all 640 balanced words, 320 reverse-complement orbits, and 120 individually legal orbits. Inspected certificate.json class assignment and independently checked all 583 distinct same-class orbit pairs are mutually incompatible, giving a 12-class clique cover and bound ≤12 orbits. Independently verified the 12 printed representatives generate 24 balanced, reverse-complement closed, mutually non-overlapping words. This finite exhaustive proof covers the entire stated five-mer domain.
